nodes.name: decode.go
nodes.summary: Safe PEM decoding helpers that enforce size limits and structure checks before parsing certificates, CSRs, and private keys.
nodes.languageNotes: Bounds are derived from worst-case 16k-bit RSA keys and realistic trust-bundle sizes to mitigate resource exhaustion.

nodes.name: vault.go
nodes.summary: In-memory fake implementation of the Vault issuer interface used in unit tests.

nodes.name: vault.go
nodes.summary: Client implementation for the HashiCorp Vault issuer, handling authentication methods, token lifecycle, and certificate signing.

nodes.name: features.go
nodes.summary: Registers the cert-manager webhook component's feature gates independently from the other components.

nodes.name: scheme.go
nodes.summary: Defines the runtime scheme and codec containing only cert-manager external API types, deliberately without defaulting or conversion functions.
nodes.languageNotes: Separating external-only types keeps controllers from applying webhook-owned defaulting semantics.

nodes.name: conditions.go
nodes.summary: Helpers for reading and setting Issuer, Certificate, and CertificateRequest conditions with observed-generation semantics.

nodes.name: safeDecodeInternal
nodes.summary: Applies a maximum-size check and decodes exactly one PEM block of the expected type.

nodes.name: SafeDecodePrivateKey
nodes.summary: Safely decodes a PEM-encoded private key with a size limit.

nodes.name: SafeDecodeCSR
nodes.summary: Safely decodes a PEM-encoded certificate signing request with a size limit.

nodes.name: SafeDecodeSingleCertificate
nodes.summary: Safely decodes a single PEM-encoded X.509 certificate with a size limit.

nodes.name: SafeDecodeCertificateChain
nodes.summary: Safely decodes a PEM-encoded certificate chain with an overall size limit.

nodes.name: SafeDecodeCertificateBundle
nodes.summary: Safely decodes a PEM-encoded trust bundle with an upper size bound.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.summary: Fake Vault issuer that records sign requests and returns configurable responses for tests.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Creates a fake Vault issuer with optional signing overrides.

nodes.name: Sign
nodes.summary: Returns the configured fake signed certificate for a CSR.

nodes.name: WithSign
nodes.summary: Configures the fake issuer to return specific certificate and CA PEM data.

nodes.name: WithNew
nodes.summary: Configures the constructor hook used by the fake Vault issuer.

nodes.name: IsVaultInitializedAndUnsealed
nodes.summary: Reports the configured Vault initialization and seal status.

nodes.name: Interface
nodes.summary: Interface for Vault issuer implementations that sign CSRs and report Vault health.

nodes.name: Client
nodes.summary: Abstraction over the Vault API client used by the issuer.

nodes.name: Vault
nodes.summary: Vault issuer implementation holding configuration, secret lister access, and token state.

nodes.name: New
nodes.summary: Creates a Vault issuer client bound to the given namespace, secret lister, and Issuer resource.

nodes.name: Sign
nodes.summary: Signs a PEM-encoded CSR through the Vault PKI backend and returns the certificate chain.

nodes.name: setToken
nodes.summary: Authenticates to Vault using the configured auth method and stores the resulting token.

nodes.name: newConfig
nodes.summary: Builds the Vault client configuration, including TLS settings and CA bundles.

nodes.name: caBundle
nodes.summary: Loads and validates the CA bundle used to verify the Vault server certificate.

nodes.name: clientCertificate
nodes.summary: Builds the client certificate and key pair used for Vault TLS authentication.

nodes.name: tokenRef
nodes.summary: Reads a Vault token from a Kubernetes Secret reference.

nodes.name: appRoleRef
nodes.summary: Reads AppRole credentials from Kubernetes Secret references.

nodes.name: requestTokenWithAppRoleRef
nodes.summary: Exchanges AppRole credentials for a Vault token.

nodes.name: requestTokenWithClientCertificate
nodes.summary: Authenticates to Vault using the client certificate auth method and returns a token.

nodes.name: requestTokenWithKubernetesAuth
nodes.summary: Authenticates to Vault using Kubernetes service account auth and returns a token.

nodes.name: extractCertificatesFromVaultCertificateSecret
nodes.summary: Extracts certificate and CA data from a Vault certificate secret response.

nodes.name: IsVaultInitializedAndUnsealed
nodes.summary: Queries Vault health endpoints to report whether it is initialized and unsealed.

nodes.name: IssuerHasCondition
nodes.summary: Reports whether an Issuer has a condition of the given type with True status.

nodes.name: SetIssuerCondition
nodes.summary: Adds or updates an Issuer condition while preserving observed generation and timestamps.

nodes.name: CertificateHasCondition
nodes.summary: Reports whether a Certificate has a condition of the given type with True status.

nodes.name: CertificateHasConditionWithObservedGeneration
nodes.summary: Reports whether a Certificate condition is True and matches the current generation.

nodes.name: GetCertificateCondition
nodes.summary: Returns the Certificate condition of the requested type, if present.

nodes.name: GetCertificateRequestCondition
nodes.summary: Returns the CertificateRequest condition of the requested type, if present.

nodes.name: SetCertificateCondition
nodes.summary: Adds or updates a Certificate condition, managing timestamps and observed generation.

nodes.name: RemoveCertificateCondition
nodes.summary: Removes a Certificate condition of the given type.

nodes.name: SetCertificateRequestCondition
nodes.summary: Adds or updates a CertificateRequest condition with status timestamps.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestHasCondition
nodes.summary: Reports whether a CertificateRequest has a True condition of the given type.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestReadyReason
nodes.summary: Returns the reason from the Ready condition of a CertificateRequest.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestInvalidRequestMessage
nodes.summary: Returns the message from an InvalidRequest condition of a CertificateRequest.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestHasInvalidRequest
nodes.summary: Reports whether a CertificateRequest carries an InvalidRequest condition.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestIsApproved
nodes.summary: Reports whether a CertificateRequest has been approved.

nodes.name: CertificateRequestIsDenied
nodes.summary: Reports whether a CertificateRequest has been denied.
